long_biography.plain_text:
Retiring painters Heinz Rieck and Joachim Germann supplied Philip Mecklenburg and Klaus Dreyer with HPM's starting point in 1989: two Hamburg contractors and a garage beside their homes. Mecklenburg was already a master painter; his father ran an established Kiel decorating business that joined the platform four years later. Profits from work in eastern Germany helped finance further acquisitions, while each local company kept its own name.

The group later moved beyond painting into electrical and technical building services, windows and façades. Mecklenburg built a decentralised succession model in which local managers retain operating responsibility and central teams provide specialist support. He remains a shareholder and group managing director of the family-run platform across Germany and Austria, pursuing growth through both acquisitions and existing businesses.
